names.ja: エクメア・ファシアータ

light.best.quote: This plant prefers bright, indirect light to partial shade.

light.directSun.quote: Bromeliads need in-direct sunlight to grow well and produce flowers

temperature.minC.quote: Bromeliads prefer temperatures from 60F to 85F to survive and grow well.

temperature.idealC.quote: The plant thrives in temperatures between 65 to 75 degrees Fahrenheit.

humidity.reason: 出典に湿度の記載がないため「ふつう」とした

watering.growing.quote: Keep their cup filled with water, but allow the potting mix to dry between watering.

watering.winter.quote: Watering should be reduced during the winter months.

tips.ja: 中心の筒に約2.5cm水をため、月に1回入れ替える（ボウフラなどを防ぐ）。
tips.quote: The water in the central cup needs to be removed and changed once a month

tips.ja: 花は一度咲くと株は枯れる（子株が育つ）。
tips.quote: It blooms only once and then dies.
